title: Distributed Human Data Engine (DHDE): analysis pipeline for 'A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Instrument for Measuring Regional Human Mobility'
description: Source code and reproducibility pipeline for the Measurement (Elsevier) article (DOI: 10.1016/j.measurement.2026.122500). Reproduces the reported results (in-sample R2 = 0.810, chronological hold-out R2 = 0.683, MAE = 1,793 visits/day). Data provenance and the exact pinned data commit required to reproduce the published numbers are documented in DATA_PROVENANCE.md. Released under the MIT License.
